summary: Pass at d06690a0. All round-2 findings (RB8-01 to RB8-07, review A F1, review C F2 and F3) are fixed and each fix is proven by a test: the Red run at 3509efd5 fails exactly T162-T168, T171, and T172 (9 failed | 12 passed, exit 1), the gate run passes 21 of 21 (exit 0), and three mutation batches each fail exactly the tests that cover the removed fixes. Regression claim: the gate with tests/storytime-picture-rows.test.ts and tests/storytime-book-pictures.test.ts exited 1 with Tests 2 failed | 139 passed (141). The two failures are T142 and T147, the known picture list version 3 pin failures routed to Phase 4. This change added no failure.

The worktree file was restored and the restore was asserted.

Mutation batch B (removed the delivery-target symlink refusal and the wx flag, and moved the manifest write before the copies): Tests 2 failed | 19 passed, failing exactly T165 and T170. Review A F1 is closed: T170 fails when the manifest moves before the copies. The worktree file was restored and the restore was asserted.

Mutation batch C (removed the palette, depth, space, and channel checks of inspectColorPrint): Tests 1 failed | 20 passed, failing exactly T171. Review C F2 is closed. The worktree file was restored and the restore was asserted.

Gap probes: deleting the deliver CLI onSkip wiring line kept 21 passed (F-A1); removing the absent-measurement pin branch kept 21 passed, and that branch is redundant because the mismatch check still refuses an absent hash, so the contract behavior survives (no finding).

T152 to T161 keep their meaning: the Red commit changed one import line (symlink added to node:fs/promises) and no test body. Green changed no test. The test file gained no new top-level import; the new exports are read through dynamic import helpers.

Contract: the manifest.json shape is unchanged. The 19359dd1..d06690a0 diff in src/storytime/book-pictures.ts touches only the deliver block, and assembleManifest and StorytimeManifest are untouched. The approval list schema gained only the optional pictureListSha256 field. spec.md Amendment 2026-11-01 decision 2 points 1 to 6 are unchanged, so no PM contract change and no escalation.

Callers and error paths: resolveMuseDeliveryPaths is called by the deliver CLI and covered by T163 and T164; writeMuseDelivery options are additive, so the older call shape in T152 to T161 still works; rowCaptureJob is unchanged. Every refusal writes nothing: pin refusal (T162), path refusal (T164), target symlink refusal (T165), duplicate names (T166), degenerate names (T167), Muse print refusals (T168), malformed list (T169), copy write failure (T170), and format refusals (T171) all assert no manifest and an empty folder; the rejection helper throws when no rejection occurs, so no test passes vacuously.

Anti-patterns: A3 clean, all count assertions read labeled typed values, no digit parsing of output text. A4 clean, each refusal test pairs with a safe acceptance case and the rejection helper blocks vacuous pass. A5 clean, the plan Red, Green, and regression claims match the live runs above. One extra probe: os.lstat on a missing parent with a 300-character name returned errno 2 (ENOENT), so the plan wording that T170 fails at the copy write with ENAMETOOLONG is correct.
